catalyst.name: Calculated Balance, Vex Mythoclast Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Landing 15 hits within 3 seconds of each, or scoring a kill, grants 20% increased damage, 20 Stability, and 20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds.
Buff applies to Auto Rifle mode only.

damage.expr: $clarity[Temporal Unlimiter]("deal 1475") * $quantum[primaries-fusion-rifle-vex-mythoclast].precisionDamage / ($compendium[Vex Mythoclast]("Fusion Bolts deal 66") * $compendium[Vex Mythoclast]("1.8x Precision Multiplier"))
damage.note: Clarity's linear shot (1475) carried to Quantum's scale by the ratio of Quantum's precision hit to the Compendium's bolt (66 x 1.8)

share.note: 80 % of the hits landed, rounded up
